bns:Component.name: HARM - Postgres Upsert Golden Product (No AWS SKU)
bns:Component.bns:description: For golden records with no AWS listing (positional binding: 6 params). Clears aws_sku on conflict. | built with boomi-companion v1.0.107

field.value: insert into public.harm_golden_products (golden_id, gtin, harmonized_sku, name, price, shopify_sku, updated_at) values (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, now()) on conflict (gtin) do update set golden_id = excluded.golden_id, harmonized_sku = excluded.harmonized_sku, name = excluded.name, price = excluded.price, shopify_sku = excluded.shopify_sku, aws_sku = null, updated_at = now()
